intro: Today's coverage highlights ongoing border tensions with Azerbaijan, Armenia's deepening ties with the EU and Iran, the launch of a national AI and robotics program, and the start of railway concession talks with Russia. Diaspora advocacy in New York and cultural events in Russia also feature prominently.

topics.title: Azerbaijani soldier crosses border, shoots at Armenian civilian in Syunik
topics.text: An Azerbaijani soldier spent five days inside Armenia's sovereign territory before firing six rounds at a woman in the Syunik region, threatening her children and stealing personal belongings. The incident marks a serious violation of the border and has drawn condemnation from Armenian officials.

sources.title: Azerbaijani Soldier Was in Armenia-Proper for 5 Days Before Shooting 6 Rounds at Syunik Mother
Azerbaijan soldier who illegally crossed Armenia border fired 6 shots at Armenian woman, threatened her children with firearm, stole money, phone, 2 left shoes

topics.title: Armenia and EU advance strategic partnership and energy cooperation
topics.text: Foreign Minister Ararat Mirzoyan met with the EU Enlargement Commissioner in Brussels to discuss the implementation of the strategic partnership agenda. Germany's Foreign Minister emphasized the importance of preventing Russian influence from growing in the South Caucasus while supporting the peace process between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

topics.title: Armenia launches seven-year AI and robotics development program
topics.text: The government has approved a seven-year program aimed at advancing physical AI and robotics capabilities. The initiative is set to be a key focus at the upcoming Digitec 2026 conference, signaling a strategic push toward high-tech economic development.

sources.title: AI Economy to Take the Stage at Digitec 2026

topics.title: Armenia and Russia begin negotiations on railway concession future
topics.text: Yerevan and Moscow have held their first talks regarding the future of the South Caucasus Railway concession agreement. Armenian officials indicate the discussions focused on the effectiveness of the current arrangement, while the legislature chair noted Russia is not inclined to restore the railway infrastructure.

topics.title: Armenia expands energy cooperation with Iran, including potential oil refinery
topics.text: High-level meetings between Armenian and Iranian officials, including the infrastructure minister and Iran's vice president, focused on expanding energy sector cooperation. Tehran has expressed readiness to build an oil refinery in Armenia, signaling a deepening of bilateral economic ties.

topics.title: Diaspora advocacy leads to removal of Azerbaijani flag from New York park
topics.text: Armenian Americans in New York successfully campaigned for the removal of an Azerbaijani 'Victory Day' flag displayed at Bowling Green Park. The action highlights the active role of the diaspora in countering Azerbaijani narratives in the United States.

topics.title: Three years after 2020 war, Artsakh conflict remains unresolved per new reports
topics.text: Updated analyses from ANC-International and other observers conclude that the conflict over Artsakh remains unresolved three years after the ceasefire. The publications underscore the lack of a comprehensive peace settlement and the ongoing humanitarian and political consequences.
